outreach_sequence.subject: Scaling revenue operations at Anthropic following Series C - $75M led by Horizon Ventures
outreach_sequence.body:
Hi Alex,

Congrats on Anthropic's recent momentum with Series C - $75M led by Horizon Ventures! Noticed your team's expansion into enterprise automation.

We help high-growth sales teams cut account research from 45 minutes to 60 seconds per lead while boosting response rates.

Would you be open to a brief 10-minute chat next Tuesday?

Best regards,
B2B SDR Automation Team
Hi Alex — saw Anthropic's impressive growth and expansion into enterprise software. Would love to connect and share how leading RevOps teams are automating account research.

outreach_sequence.subject: Re: Scaling revenue operations at Anthropic
outreach_sequence.body:
Hi Alex,

Following up on my previous note. Given Anthropic's focus on market expansion, I thought you might appreciate seeing a 60-second workflow demo.

Do you have 5 minutes open later this week?

Best regards,
B2B SDR Automation Team
